statement: An entity that must pay withheld amounts to the Commissioner of Taxation (including amounts withheld from salary or wages under the PAYG withholding rules) must apply to register with the Commissioner in the approved form by the day on which it is first required to withhold an amount, unless the Commissioner allows a longer period.
caveat: Contravention attracts an administrative penalty of 5 penalty units. In practice the registration is added to the entity's ABN through ATO online services or the combined business registration flows, and withheld amounts are then reported through Single Touch Payroll.
